purpose: Remove the failing runtime presentation route, restore the exact 14-part transport independently verified against the approved source and retained in commit 2570ab7fdf9ccbf955f140ba9740e7cb30a85766, validate it by exact Brotli/PDF SHA-256 during the web build, apply the deterministic Gekta frame correction, and let Next.js serve the generated public PDF from the unchanged download URL.
requiredBehavior: No Brotli decompression or PDF reconstruction runs in the production request path.
The build fails closed unless the compressed source is exactly 198423 bytes with SHA-256 e99c503bb653bfc1f4c2fd800a5bc230404a6d22d02f3d1362cb66e1172b0612.
The build fails closed unless the reconstructed base PDF is exactly 312533 bytes, 14 pages and SHA-256 1f99bd881404624ef8fe8bec9a10caf10a021f8cacff3ed5a6633101255178a5.
The generated PDF preserves the approved presentation and deterministic Gekta frame correction.
Two independent production downloads must return HTTP 200, application/pdf and identical non-empty PDF bytes.
forbiddenChanges: authentication, registration, API, database, roles, tenants or Gekta runtime logic
production release gates, secrets, external storage or recurring cost
